options.name: deploy
options.description: Whether or not to deploy artifacts after building them. When this option is V(false) all the functions are built, but no stack update is run to send them out. This is mostly useful for generating artifacts to be stored/deployed elsewhere.

options.name: force
options.description: Whether or not to force full deployment, equivalent to serverless C(--force) option.

options.name: region
options.description: AWS region to deploy the service to. This parameter defaults to V(us-east-1).

options.name: serverless_bin_path
options.description: The path of a serverless framework binary relative to the O(service_path), for example V(node_module/.bin/serverless).

options.name: service_path
options.description: The path to the root of the Serverless Service to be operated on.

options.name: stage
options.description: The name of the serverless framework project stage to deploy to. This uses the serverless framework default "dev".

options.name: verbose
options.description: Shows all stack events during deployment, and display any Stack Output.
